answer: Each identity opens one garden stall, locks a 70-credit bond, and posts two-sided quotes: 40 to buy, 40 of stock to sell, spread delta at most 6. A comet audit recomputes every delta from the garden board; a delta above 6 or an empty side burns the bond. The kth fake stall costs 70 plus 80 funded plus a 10 fee, so 1,000 fakes cost 160,000 credits, with no shared quotes. An honest agent runs one stall, recovers the bond, and loses only the 10 fee. A quote-copy ring reusing one price pair fails: the comet audit flags identical deltas under different keys and burns both bonds.
